tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ro snyoms nges pa can 'chad thabs 'gro mgon zhal gyi lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes kun 'dus pa'i// don gnyis phun tshogs yon tan mchog gis brgyan// mkhyen pa gnyis ldan shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// chos rje 'gro mgon zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// mchog gi sprul pa grub thob 'phreng ba dang*// bye ba'i grangs snyed gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bar chad sel mdzad dam chos skyong rnams kyis// thugs dam bzhin dgongs 'di dag rgyal gyur cig /'dir rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying phyung ba/ nā ro paṇa chen gyi thugs kyi dgongs pa/ zhal gyi bdud rtsi/ nad 'don rtog pa lam 'khyer/ ro snyoms skor drug gi gdams pa 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa dkyus kyi rim pa gnyis/ dang po la de la slob dpon til+li pa'i byin rlabs kyis nā ro pa'i thugs la shar lugs/ ti pus ras chung pa la gnang lugs/ des snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag la gdams lugs// de lta bu'i rtog pa lam khyer gdams ngag gi mtshan bstan pa dang bzhi'o// 1 gnyis pa ti pus ras chung pa la gnang lugs la/ gnang ba de lta bu'i nus dngos dang*/ mtshams rje mi bskyod sbyor gyis tshigs su bcad pas/ brgyud pa la gsol ba gdab pa/ ti pus rje ti pu'i ras chung pa la sbos shig par gdams pa/ ras chung pas bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub lugs so// de la gnyis te/ mdor bla ma'i gsung ni bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyor gyi gsol ba gdab de nas bla ma'i pa dang*/ bka' lnga brgya dus kyi bzhin bsgrub pa dngos so// gsum pa snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag la gdams lugs la lnga ste/ gdams pa phyi ma'i dus kyi 'di'i bcad thabs dang*/ snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag snying tig gdams ngag gzhan la sbyin mi sbyin gyi dmigs bsal bstan pa dang*/ spyir rgya gar chos kyi

rgya gar nas gdams ngag 'di rnams thon pa la 'di ltar byas lugs dang*/ gdams bod phrug rgya gar ngag yod kyang nyams su ma blangs na byang chub mi thob par bstan pa dang*/ 'di lta bu'i rtog pa lam khyer gdams ngag rgya bod gnyis na mi bdog pas thugs la chongs shig par gdams pa'o// gnyis pa mngon par rtogs pa dkyus kyi rim pa la/ khog don lus rnam gzhag dang*/ gzhung don man ngag gnyis so// dang po la/ phyogs gar 'chi ba dang gtogs pa dang*/ tshig tshig dang don ji lta bus bsdus pa dang*/ ming bzang rtog 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum mo// gnyis pa gzhung don man ngag la drug ste/ rnam rtog lam du khyer ba ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i gdams ngag nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer ba dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag lha 'dre lam du 'khyer ba bar chad dngos grub tu bsdud pa'i gdams ngag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lam du 'khyer ba byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag na tsha lam du 'khyer ba 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag 'chi ba lam du khyer ba ma bu ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag go /dang po la gnyis te/ de la dang por dpon slob kyi rten 'brel brtsi ba dang*/ nyams su blang ba gnyis/ de la gsum ste/ dbang po dbang po tha ma tha ma gzigs mo bzhi'i sgo nasanyams su blang ba/ 2 'bring rnam shes 'khyam po 'bring rnam shes dang srid pa gsum gyi ngo sprod byas la nyams su blang ba/ 3 rab dus dbang po rab gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo sprod byas la rang res rang ngo shes par bya'o// 4gnyis pa nyon mongs pa lam du khyer ba dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag la bzhi ste/ snang ba nyon mongs pa de sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ snang ba de ltar phyi 'byung ba sems su ma shes pas mngal du zhugs nas sha khrag gi sbubs su tshud pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 5 der snang ba de ltar lus su sems su ma shes pas yul la chags sdang skye lugs dang*/

6 de lam du khyer lugs so// de la dug gsum dbang po rab/ 'bring 'bring gis tha ma dbang po tha ma gsum mo/ 7 /gsum pa lha 'dre lam du khyer ba bar chad dngos grub tu bsdud pa'i gdams ngag la bzhi ste/ kun tu de ltar bzang po'i spyod pa/ gsang ba'i spyod pa/ tshogs kyi spyod pa/ phyogs de ltar tshogs spyod mthar las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa'o/ 13 /gnyis pa la/ mdor de la bstan pa bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis so// de la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po sngon 'gro la/ rdzu 'phrul de yang spyod pa bsgrub pa la/ gsang spyod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ gsang gang gi ring sngags pa tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ gos su ro yi thal ba ci bgo ba dang*/ rgyan du guñja na ci gdags pa dang*/ cho ga 'jam pa'i rdo rje gsum bya ba dang lnga'o/ 8 /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gnas ri bo dang ni gang du gsang spyod la 'gro ba/ dus mtshan mo nam 'gro ba/ spyod lam gsangs te gsang dgos par bstan pa/ gsang spyod nus pa sngags pas rnyed pa rnams kyi 'gro sa mchog tu bstan pa/ spyod pa ci bya na/ spros bcas ba spu spros med shin tu shin tu spros med gnyis ni gsum bya ba/ sbyin par mkha' 'gro ma ci btang na phyi nang gi tshogs 'khor btang ba dang*/ 9 spros bcas de yang gal te bdag dpe ji lta bu'i spyod pa bya ba/ zas su ci za na bza' dang zas kyi ro mnyam pa/ gnas dur khrod la sogs/ de rnams su gdengs ci lta bus 'gro ba/ bdud kyi brgya sbyin bar chad byung na ji ltar lam du khyer ba dang bcu'o// 10 gsum pa rjes la/ snying rje med na sems can rjes su theg pa chen por mi 'gro bas byang chub sems dpa' lha 'dre'i don bya ba/ tshogs spyod byed spyod pa byed pa la gsang spyod dus ji srid du bya na rdzu 'phrul ma thob kyi bar bya ba dang gnyis so// 11 gsum pa tshogs spyod la/

sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum mo// dang po la/ gsang spyod cung zad drod mthar phyin nas spyod pa la 'gro ba dang*/ rgyan du rna ba dag ci gdags pa dang*/ gos su stag gi lpags pa/ ci bgo ba dang*/ bla ma la 'bul ba lus ni ci 'bul ba dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lus 'dod pa byung na ji ltar bya skal dang skal ba dang*/ zas su bza' dang ci za ba dang*/ 'jig rten rme gtsang gyi rtog pa gzhom pa dang*/ 12 gzugs he ru ka cir bsgyur ba dang*/ grogs gang bzhin mdzes dang 'grogs pa dang*/ lag char shes rab kha ṭ+wāṃ ci 'khyer ba dang*/ lag chas rnge chung rang gzhan gnyis kyi dgos pa dang*/ spyod pa'i sbyin sreg gegs lus ngag gi chos spyod bzhag pa dang*/ spyod pa'i dam tshig sdom las dus su gsang sngags spyi'i dam tshig mi bsrung ba dang*/ dam tshig tu rdo shing bla ma ma gtogs pa la phyag mi 'tshal ba dang*/ spros bcas gnyis ni 'ba' zhig gzhan gyi spyod pa mi bya ba dang bcu gcig go /rjes la gsum ste/ sems can thams cad sems can kun la snying rje chen po dang mi 'bral bar dgos pa dang*/ yul la bstod na dga' chags sdang skyes na slar log la gsang spyod bya ba dang*/ chos brgyad chos brgyad mgo bo mgo bo snyoms nas zla ba gsum lon pa dang spyod pa mthar phyin pa'o// bzhi pa sdug bsngal lam du khyer ba byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag la bzhi ste/ las de ltar rtog pa dang nyon mongs pa gnyis rgyu 'bras su 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ las las ni lus dkar nag gsog lugs/ 14 smin lugs 'bras bu smin bzhi bstan pa/ 15 de lam de ltar sems can thams cad du khyer ba'o/ 16 /lnga pa na tsha lam du khyer ba 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag la/ nad ngos bzung ba/ gsor rung mi rung gi dmigs bsal bstan pa/ nad 'don pa dang gsum mo// dang po gnyis te lha 'dre'i lha 'dre'i nad nad dang*/ rang bzhin gyi nad do// de la bzhi ste/

'byung ba lus dang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad/ nyon mongs dug dang po nyon mongs pa gsum gyi nad/ 17 lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad/ rnam rtog gi dper na nad ngos bzung ba'o/ 19 /gsum pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad ngos bzung ba la/ mdor bsgom skyon bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ de la lus sha dang rus pa la/ 'thems pa/ 'chus 'chus pa de pa/ lhag pa lhag pa chu gsum/ ngag la log pa srog 'dzin rlung / 18 'tshubs stod du 'tshubs pa/ gtor skyon yon ba gsum/ yid la 'byams pa 'byams pa/ 'dus 'dus pa pa/ stengs pa stengs pa gsum ste dgu'o// gnyis pa gsor rung mi rung gi dmigs bsal bstan pa la/ bcos su bag bzhi sa la mi btub pa dang*/ bcos su bla ma la gus btub pa gnyis so// gsum pa nad 'don pa la gsum ste/ spyi'i nad 'don dang*/ bye brag so so'i nad 'don dang*/ nad bzhi lta ba'i go cha 'don gyi mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po la/ rab lta bas 'don pa/ 'bring dmigs pas 'don pa 'di/ bsgom pas 'don pa/ tha ma lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bca' ba las kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi 'don pa gsum mo/ 19 /dang po/ rab lta bas 'don pa la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po la gnyis te/ lung bstan pa mi brjed gzung dang*/ mtshams bca' ba lus kyi sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mdor bstan pa rtogs ldan dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la gsum ste/ dang por ngos bzung*/ bar du bdag 'dzin blos btang*/ tha ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal ba'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ nad dang gdon ci dgu rtog par thag bcad pa dang*/ rtog pa'i sems la ci yang rang bzhin chos skur bstan pa/ chos sangs rgyas sku'i ngang nas 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dpe bstan pa/ sdug bsngal nyams su blang ba'o// de la gsum ste/ na tsha byung na nad la sman phyi'i rkyen la mi bltos pa dang*/ nad rgyun chad 'don gyi rtsa ba bla ma'i ltem rkyang med mos gus su bstan pa/

gdams ngag la yid ches pas des drag la yun ring bar nyams su blang ba'o/ 20 /gnyis pa bar du bdag 'dzin blos btang ba la/ sdug bsngal kun gyi rtsa ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba ngos bzung ba dang*/ de'i gnyen po nyams su blang ba'o// de la gnyis te/ gnas lugs nyams su blang ba dang*/ rtog chos nyams su blang ba gnyis so// dang po la bzhi ste/ lta bas 'dzin pa med gtan la dbab pa dang*/ sgom pas lam khad bor lus sems phral la bzhag pa dang*/ de'i 'bras de ltar bdag bu rang sar grol bar bstan pa dang*/ lta sgom gcig res 'ga' nam tu dril nas spros bcas spyod pa bya'o// gnyis pa rtog chos nyams su blang ba la/ so sor nad dang gdon rtog pa'i shes rab kyis yang nas yang du stong pa nyid du lta ba dang*/ nad 'don des kyang ma gnyen po rtog pa glau bur can la thog brdzis btang ba/ 21 don bsdus la nyams su blang pa dang gsum mo// de la bzhi ste/ nad 'don de ltar ston gyi sngon du bla ma la gsol ba 'debs dgos par bstan pa dang*/ bla ma'i de lta bu yi zhal nas ci gsung tshad mar bzung ba/ gnas lugs ngo sprad pa dang*/ kun rdzob bdag gi zhi 'dod byang chub sems kyis gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang du blang ba'o// gsum pa gnas lugs ngo sprad pa la bzhi ste/ nad glo bur glo bur ba skad cig mar bstan pa/ sgyu lus snying po med pa ngo sprad pa/ rnam rtog gzhi rtsa med rtsa chad du ngo sprad pa/ sems chos spros dang bral skur ngo sprad pa'o// gsum pa tha ma re dogs kyi 'phrang bsal ba la/ dang por nad ngos bzung ba gal te gsos su / nad la me de nyid thob rtsa gdabs pa/ dug bdud rtsir rnam rtog chos ngo sprad pa/ lha 'drer mi gnyen po dgag gzung ba dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa/ bye brag so so'i nad 'don la gnyis te/ lha 'dre'i nad 'dre cha ba gdon dang*/ rang bzhin gyi nad 'don pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ 'byung ba 'khrug pa'i

slob dpon nā ro nad 'don/ nyon mongs nyon mongs 'dod chags/ dug gsum gyi nad 'don/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad 'don/ rnam rtog gi nad 'don no rtog pa'i nad du/ 22 /dang po la/ mdor sa la rlung bstan/ 'byung chung ro snyoms kyi rgyas par bshad pa gnyis so// de la gegs sel ba dang*/ nad 'don pa gnyis so// dang po la/ sgom skyon bcos thabs dang*/ 23 /rlung 'byongs pa'i tshad gnyis so// de la tha ma lus ni/ 'bring dbugs dang*/ rab gsum nam mkha' la mo// gnyis pa nad 'don la gsum ste/ nad ngos bzung ba/ de 'don pa/ mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po la/ bad kan gyi nad yin pa'i rtags phyi rtags lus lci// grang ba'i nad yin pa'i rtags chu shas/ tshad nad yin pa'i rtags me shas/ rlung gi nad yin pa'i rtags rlung shas dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa de 'don pa la/ bad kan de ltar ro/ /gtor ba'i thabs/ grang ba skem pa'i chu shas che na thabs/ tshad pa gsad pa'i me'i ro shas thabs/ rlung mnan pa'i rlung shas che thabs dang bzhi'o// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba la/ 'byung ba bzhi'i me chu shas che mjug bsdu ba/ gzhi 'gron gyi spyir nad gzhi nad ngos bzung nas zas bcos bstan pa/ rje mi la'i zhal gdams bzhi gsum bcu gnyis 'byung bzhi ro kyi mjug bsdu ba/ bla ma ti bu'i zhal gdams bcu gnyis kyi dmigs pa gsal mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi'o/ 24 /gsum pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad 'don la/ mdor spyir lus skyon bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum mo// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la dgu ste/ lus la sha dang rus pa 'thems pa bcos pa/ 'chus lus gnad pa bcos pa/ lhags pa sku mnye bcos pa/ ngag la log 'bring sgo ba bcos pa/ 'tshubs pa bcos stod nad thams cad pa/ gtor ba bcos log gnon rlung lnga pa/ yid la 'byams pa rgod pa ste bcos pa/ 'dus pa bcos pa byi'u snying*/ ltengs pa bcos zhi gnas kyi pa'o// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba la gnyis te/

ngos ma zin skyon rnams ngos pa'i dpe dang*/ bcos pa'i 'thems pa dang thabs so// drug pa 'chi ba lam du khyer ba ma bu ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag la/ dbang po tha ma bskyed rim dbang po tha ma la 'phos pa skye ba 'dzin pa'i sa/ 'bring sgyu lus la 'phos 'bring bar do'i pa dus kyi/ rab 'od gsal la 'phos pa mngon dga'i sa dang gsum mo// de la chos rab rtogs pa skur sangs rgya tshul/ longs de'i ngang nas skur sangs rgya tshul/ sprul skur sems can mos pa sangs rgya tshul/ ngo bo sku gsum po de yang tha mi dad nyid kyi skur sangs rgya ba'i tshul dang bzhi'o/ 25 /de lta bu'i sa bcad 'di ni nor bu 'od kyi sgron mer dar thums ma ji lta ba drangs snang zhing*/ lo rgyus dang 'byung tshul ro snyoms gnyis la rlung gis mdzad 'dug pa bzhin go bde bar bsgrigs pas/ mkhas blun kun phyogs 'dir 'jug pa bde ba dang*/ phyi rabs kyis bsnan pa'i sa dpyad dag ni gzhung dang mi 'grig par ma zad/ 'ga' re rtog btags su 'dug pa dor ba'i ched du 'di yang pad+ma dkar pos bsgrigs pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ//
